message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts: operating a medical clinic without a license, after administrative penalties, continuing illegal practice. Under Chinese Criminal Law, the relevant offense is "非法行医罪" (illegal medical practice). Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But the specific provision is Article 336 of Criminal Law: "非法行医罪". The fact mentions self-surrender and self-report, which gives self-surrender mitigation, but not a separate crime. So only one crime: illegal medical practice. Could there be "逃税" etc? No. So answer: [罪名]非法行医<eoa>.

Check format: single crime: [罪名]非法行医<eoa>.
